controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-19T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:08:28.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND message LIKE "*Failed password*"
| STATS daily_count = COUNT(*)
        BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| SORT day ASC
